description: This file defines a custom exception class for the Amazon Chime SDK Meetings service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends a general AWS exception class and is used to handle errors specific to interactions with the Chime SDK Meetings API.

classes.name: ChimeSDKMeetingsException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing errors interacting with the Amazon Chime SDK Meetings service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Inherited constructor from AwsException, initializes the exception object.
